title: External timeline and remediation register: multi-region capacity outage (Mar 2026)
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Purpose: produce a single customer-facing timeline, statuspage edits, and an actionable remediation register tied to the March multi-region capacity outage. Goals: (1) publish a clear external timeline with root-cause summary, (2) provide customers with mitigation actions and short-term workarounds, (3) track engineering action items with owners and SLAs, and (4) coordinate PR/CS briefings and follow-ups. This ticket consolidates comms drafts, approvals, and the action tracker for cross-team visibility.
timeline_summary: 2026-03-01 02:14 UTC - First customer reports of elevated 5xx errors in eu-west-1. 2026-03-01 02:22 UTC - Oncall paged; initial mitigation: scale-up of reserved pools in region. 2026-03-01 02:35 UTC - Autoscaler failed to converge due to a regression in the heartbeat backoff logic (deploy 2026-02-28). 2026-03-01 02:50 UTC - Fallback routing enabled to secondaries; partial recovery observable. 2026-03-01 04:10 UTC - Full mitigation: rollback of heartbeat change and manual capacity rebalance. 2026-03-02 09:00 UTC - Customer-facing statuspage posted with incident acknowledged. 2026-03-03 11:15 UTC - Internal RCA draft created. 2026-03-10 16:30 UTC - Postmortem review with ENG/PM/Support; action items agreed.
action_items: AO-1: Patch heartbeat backoff logic to respect configured limits; owner: Priya Nair; due: 2026-03-11
AO-2: Add end-to-end autoscaler integration test covering extreme scaling path; owner: Jorge Martinez; due: 2026-03-18
AO-3: Create an automated runbook to switch traffic to secondaries and validate KV cache warming; owner: Sasha Liu; due: 2026-03-17
AO-4: Statuspage messaging template and post-incident FAQ for customers; owner: Customer Ops - Hana Park; due: 2026-03-12
AO-5: Post-rollback verification harness to detect regressions in production autoscale behavior; owner: Runtime QA - Ben Cho; due: 2026-03-22
AO-6: Follow-up customer outreach to top 10 impacted tenants with credit proposal; owner: Account Mgmt - Tom Reynolds; due: 2026-03-20
comments: 2026-03-03 (Aisha R): Draft timeline uploaded to Confluence; awaiting engineering action-item assignments. Link in artifacts.
2026-03-04 (Liam O): Confirmed root cause as heartbeat backoff regression from 2026-02-28 deploy. Assigned Priya to patch. Pls review AO list for missing items.
2026-03-05 (Priya N): Patch PR created - github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4123. Includes unit tests and changelog entry. Requesting review from Jorge and Ben.
2026-03-06 (Jorge M): Noted missing integration test for the autoscaler extreme path; added as AO-2. Also flagged telemetry gap: missing spike tags when autoscale fails.
2026-03-09 (Hana P): Draft customer FAQ attached; suggests offering 10% service credit to confirmed impacted customers. Awaiting PM approval.
2026-03-10 (PM review): Reviewed by PM (E. Nakamura) - approved FAQ and credit approach. Recommend final statuspage language to avoid technical overload.
2026-03-11 (Liam O): Statuspage update scheduled for 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC after legal review. Please sign off on the external timeline by EOD 2026-03-11.
2026-03-12 (Legal): Minor edits to customer-facing wording requested; no material change. Cleared for publish.
statuspage_draft_snippet: We experienced an elevated error rate in multiple regions on 2026-03-01 due to an autoscaler regression introduced in a recent runtime deploy. We mitigated the issue by rolling back the change and rebalancing capacity. Full root cause analysis and next steps are included in our post-incident report. We apologize for the disruption and are taking steps to prevent recurrence.
closure_notes: Postmortem review complete 2026-03-10. All AO owners assigned and dates agreed. Critical patch rolled into runtime-1.20 hotfix on 2026-03-05; additional hardening and test coverage planned for runtime-1.21. Recommend closing external comms loop with top impacted customers by 2026-03-20 and scheduling a follow-up verification incident drill in Cycle 2026-W13.
